basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old tech enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. I work as a software developer at a mid-sized tech firm, and I have a passion for renewable energy and electric vehicles. In my free time, I enjoy tinkering with cars and exploring new hobbies. I’m currently single and spend most evenings online, usually from 7 PM to midnight. Weekends are often spent at local car meetups or trying out new DIY projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a long-standing interest in automotive technology. My hands-on experience comes from years of self-teaching through online forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error with my own vehicles. I keep up-to-date with the latest in EV technology through online courses and industry publications.
